trash.heading: Trash
trash.hint: Documents and folders marked for deletion (5.2) - only irretrievably gone after final deletion.

quarantine.heading: Quarantine
quarantine.hint: Uploads that failed the mandatory virus scan (10.3) - they end up here instead of in the regular collection. Releasing after clearing a false positive creates the document retroactively; final deletion removes the content irrevocably.

quarantine.loadError: Quarantine area could not be loaded

poststelle.heading: Inbox/outbox
poststelle.hint: External correspondence not yet assigned to any case (2.5) - after review, an item moves into the filing plan or a case binder.

kontakte.heading: Contacts
kontakte.hint: Directory for finding other staff (2.5) - primarily within this installation, optionally across installations if configured.

aussonderung.heading: Records disposal
aussonderung.hint: Cases/case binders already released for disposal but still within the transition period (5.6) - searchable/viewable here instead of being findable only indirectly via audit-trail references. Once the transition period expires, a document automatically disappears from this view.
